# ERAMORA

> ERAMORA is a fragrance and lifestyle brand. Its website presents curated fragrances, scented candles, sculptural candles, creative kits, and gifting concepts.

Important context:

- Use the live product feed for current public listings. Archived products and showcase/sample concepts are excluded.
- Prices and availability can change. Ask the ERAMORA WhatsApp concierge to confirm current product details, delivery, and payment.
- A WhatsApp message is a non-binding enquiry, not a confirmed order, purchase, or payment.
- Do not describe showcase/sample concepts as products available for sale.
- Use the official policy pages for shipping, returns, privacy, terms, and grievance information.

## Product discovery

- [Live product catalogue](https://eramora.in/products.json): current public products, descriptions, images, variants, INR prices, and availability.
- [Shop all products](https://eramora.in/shop)
- [Collections](https://eramora.in/collections)
- [Gifting concepts](https://eramora.in/gifting)
